subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main compaction fix ship only in the next normal release, or be isolated and backported to a 2026.7.x patch?
rationale: The released regression is verified and current main succeeds, but choosing the supported release vehicle and backport risk requires release-owner intent after the exact fix SHA is identified.

options.title: Ship Next Normal Release
options.body: Identify the exact fixing SHA, confirm focused regression coverage, and close this issue after the next normal release tag contains it.

options.title: Backport to 2026.7.x
options.body: Isolate the bounded provider-stream compaction fix and backport it after focused release-branch proof against native Ollama.

options.title: Require Provenance First
options.body: Keep release selection undecided until history identifies the exact fix and demonstrates that unrelated runtime refactors are not required.

recommendation.title: Ship Next Normal Release
recommendation.body: Identify the exact fixing SHA, confirm focused regression coverage, and close this issue after the next normal release tag contains it.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects Vincent Koc to the affected release and release-inclusion decision.
